description: Software the project installs into tools/ (managed) or detects on the machine (pre-existing). Exact versions, URLs and checksums are pinned in software.lock.json.

packages.name: jdk
packages.purpose: Java runtime and compiler for the backend (ADR-0001: plain Servlet + Waffle on embedded Tomcat). Runs Maven, JUnit tests, the SonarQube server and its Maven scanner.

packages.name: maven
packages.purpose: Backend build tool: dependencies, compilation, unit (Surefire) and integration (Failsafe) tests, JaCoCo coverage, SonarQube analysis (ADR-0008). Its local repository is kept in tools/m2 and becomes the offline Maven bundle.

packages.name: zig
packages.purpose: Self-contained C compiler (zig cc, clang-based, bundles MinGW-w64 headers) used only to build the libpg_query parser DLL (native/libpg_query). Not needed at runtime.

packages.name: libpg_query-src
packages.hashSource: pinned at first download, 2026-10-15 (GitHub publishes no checksum for tag archives; two downloads matched)
packages.purpose: PostgreSQL 18 parser extracted as a C library (BSD-3-Clause / PostgreSQL licence). Built into pg_query.dll by native/libpg_query/Build-PgQuery.ps1 for the single-statement gate and audit masking (ADR-0009, ADR-0005).

packages.name: sonarqube
packages.purpose: Local code-quality server for the 'pgweb gate' (plan section 8.3, ADR-0008), run project-locally with the project JDK and an embedded H2 database (evaluation mode). Not used at runtime; the organisation's own SonarQube replaces it in CI.

packages.name: winsw
packages.hashSource: pinned at first download, 2026-10-16 (GitHub publishes no checksum; two downloads matched; release 2023-01-28; the binary is not Authenticode-signed)
packages.purpose: Runs pgweb as a Windows service (MIT licence; self-contained x64 build, no .NET install needed). Shipped in the release bundle as service\pgweb-service.exe (Phase 12).

preexisting.name: postgresql
preexisting.purpose: Local development database and the initdb/pg_ctl binaries for throwaway test clusters (ADR-0007).

preexisting.name: node
preexisting.purpose: Frontend build (Vite) and tests (Vitest) in later phases.

preexisting.name: docker
preexisting.purpose: Not used by the project (ADR-0007, D6). Listed for transparency only.

caches.name: npm
caches.purpose: npm package cache for the frontend, E2E tests and the Sonar scanner. Copy it with tools\ to install JavaScript dependencies offline (npm ci --offline).

caches.name: playwright-browsers
caches.purpose: Where Playwright would put downloaded browsers. Kept empty: tests use the installed Microsoft Edge (channel msedge) and PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1.

caches.name: sonar-user-home
caches.purpose: SonarScanner cache (scanner engine, JRE and analyser plugins provisioned by the SonarQube server). Kept inside tools\ instead of %USERPROFILE%\.sonar.
